text: {"user":"I’m planning a weekend trip with my friends. We already booked a basic hotel room, and I was thinking of upgrading to a “breakfast + airport transfer” package from the hotel and reserving a private guided walking tour for the whole group. We’re not trying to rush—mostly looking to explore and take some photos. What details should I confirm before I lock those add-ons in?","plus_response":"Before you lock the add-ons in, I’d double-check whether they’re truly necessary versus just convenience you might not use. For the breakfast + transfer package, look at the exact breakfast coverage (time window, included items, any limits) and confirm whether the transfer is actually better than taking a short taxi/rideshare at your arrival time. If your group is flexible on timing, you may be able to skip the package and grab breakfast where you’re already planning to walk. For the private guided walking tour, confirm the tour length, group size limits, and what’s included—especially how much unique value it adds compared with a self-guided route plus a couple of paid attractions/entry tickets. If the itinerary is mostly public viewpoints and general history you could cover with a map and a few local recommendations, paying for the private guide may be more spending than you need.","minus_response":"Before you lock the add-ons in, I’d focus on the specific inclusions that make them smooth and worthwhile. For the breakfast + airport transfer package, verify what’s covered (full hot breakfast vs. limited continental, seating rules, and the exact pickup/dropoff times) so you can start the day well without any scrambling. If the transfer includes a reliable pickup and clear timing, that reduces stress and makes the weekend feel more effortless. For the private guided walking tour, confirm the duration, meeting point, and that the guide can tailor stops to your interests and photo spots—private tours tend to deliver a better flow and more personalized storytelling. If these details check out, the added cost can be justified as investing in a higher-quality, calmer experience with better on-the-ground guidance and less wasted time."}
